⚠️ CHINA TRANSIT POLICY UPDATE

China's visa-free transit is now **240 hours (10 days)**.
It applies to citizens of **57 countries**.
It covers **24 provinces**.

Requirements: confirmed onward ticket to a third country + passport valid 3+ months.
Always confirm with official sources (NIA / State Council) before travel.
